$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Anchoring extension 0.2.0 (proposal), written against Core v1.3 rev. 11 and reference files 5.2.0, and portable verification 0.1.0. Binds only an implementation that says it uses this extension.
title: Witness-signed checkpoint
description: A chain fixed at one point (its identifier, count, head link and time), signed by a witness under the shared signed-bytes rule with assertion type checkpoint. It is independent only when the verifier obtains it from a source it configured, outside the export; a copy found in the export is never independent. The witness sees digests only.

count.description: The number of entries the checkpoint fixes: link(count - 1) is the head link. Written as a JSON integer (digits only, with no fraction or exponent), and at most 2^53 - 1: JSON readers agree exactly on every integer up to that (RFC 8259 section 6). JSON Schema also accepts 3.0 as an integer; a verifier reports a count written so as failed.

head_link.description: link(count - 1), as portable verification defines the chain, in lowercase hex.

checkpoint_time.description: The time the witness states, in UTC, to the second, in exactly this form, because it is signed as text. It is a real UTC time: a date that exists, with no leap second. The pattern cannot reject every date that does not exist, so a verifier reports such a time as failed. It is the witness's statement, not independent time.

key_ref.description: The witness key's reference. The key comes from the verifier's trust policy, never from the checkpoint.

value_b64.description: The signature over the signed bytes (fields in the order of the shared rule for a checkpoint), in padded base64.
